review_markdown:
| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tiny Tune phone: `.tune-transport{position:sticky;bottom:0;…env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}` | Static transport in normal flow, `gap:10px 14px` kept | In the phone screenshot, the sticky bar is about 200px tall. It covers the instructions and would cover note buttons. Without `viewport-fit=cover`, the inset is also always `0`. A simple in-flow layout is more usable. |
| Library `textarea{font:15px/1.6 …}` | `font:16px/1.6 …` | iOS zooms in when an input under 16px gets focus, and selects already use 16px. This affects the Pattern Finder guess field. |
| Other 9 views | No change | Hierarchy, copy, contrast and touch sizes look coherent in the screenshots. Disabled Stop is intentional. |

coverage.changes: Transport moved from a sticky bar to normal flow, so it no longer covers notes or copy. Safe-area mismatch removed.
Font size set to 16px to prevent iOS focus zoom.

coverage.surface: Home, menu, guide, routes, prompts, Seed Courier, Make it clearer, claim board, planner
coverage.changes: Reviewed in the screenshots. No change needed.
